test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.**

Sure, fixing a flubbed decision isn't always (a piece of cake), but it's rarely impossible.

options.text: The family bond is closer than anything else
A task that can be accomplished very easily
Having no stand, shows favour at one time and unfavour at another

solution:
The correct answer is: "**A task that can be accomplished very easily.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**a piece of cake**" means something that is easy to do.
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is saying that fixing a mistake is not always easy, but it is usually possible.
 
• The phrase "**a piece of cake**" is a common idiom in English.
 
 
• **For example-** *The boy found the project to be a piece of cake because it was incredibly easy.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
